title: File:Jack Sim founder of the World Toilet Organisation (6725637193).jpg
depicts: Jack Sim wrapped in toilet paper, holding a plunger, sitting on a toilet: a staged WTO publicity photo
note: Flickr EXIF date 28 Jan 2005; caption 'Using humor to raise awareness for sanitation. Photo by: WTO'. Face clear, strong for the humour chapter. Year is the camera date, not independently confirmed.

title: File:The Time Magazine's Hero of Environment 2008 photo (7028931699).jpg
depicts: Jack Sim in a dark suit with a white scarf, holding a toilet roll, against a stylised toilet-paper backdrop
note: Captioned 'The Time Magazine's Hero of Environment 2008 photo', 'Provided by Jack Sim'. Black-and-white studio portrait, very usable for line tracing.

title: File:Jack Sim (WTO, 2010) - 2.jpg
depicts: Jack Sim speaking at a lectern at a World Toilet Organization / Clorox event
note: Already used for the site's portrait (pipeline/portraits/credits.json). Low-res (683x1024).

title: File:Jack Sim and Niecy Nash.jpg
depicts: Jack Sim with US actress Niecy Nash at a Clorox Toilet Products / WTO awareness campaign
note: Same June 2010 campaign. Low-res; the second person is a celebrity partner, so crop or trace Sim only.

title: File:Session 4- Jack Sim (WTO, Singapore) (5961634214).jpg
depicts: Jack Sim speaking into a microphone at the 13th SuSanA meeting, Kigali, Rwanda, 18 July 2011
note: Candid working photo in a batik-style shirt; good for the 'working for free' chapter.

title: File:Jack thinker.jpg
depicts: Jack Sim sitting on a toilet in Rodin's Thinker pose, in front of a painting of a yellow toilet
note: Taken 17 Nov 2015 by a WTO-affiliated uploader; caption 'Jack Sim thinking how to solve the global sanitation crisis'. Best single image of his humour.

title: File:2015 World Toilet Day at United Nations, New York.jpg
depicts: A giant inflatable toilet on the lawn of UN Headquarters, New York, on World Toilet Day 2015
note: Place/object photo (no people). Ties directly to the UN World Toilet Day chapter. Credit field: World Toilet Organization, Singapore.

title: File:World Toilet Day celebrations in Singapore 2016.jpg
depicts: Urgent Run participants in Singapore doing 'the Big Squat' on a road, holding a WTO banner
note: Event crowd photo, 5 Nov 2016. Jack Sim is not identified in the caption; treat as an event/place image, not a portrait.
